architecture_conclusion.text: The provisional peak V554 is a narrow reference-composed structural-affordance compiler. It composes exact original producer-owned structural facts, admission/use permission and governed authority with exact V553 temporal objects only when the V554 rule requires temporal meaning, then creates only positive/conditional bounded downstream mediation-input affordances, explicit structural requirements, downstream-meaningful semantic/use limits and optional governed affordance relations. V554_V555_HANDOFF is a governed boundary/interface family rather than V554 semantic meaning. Transport/schema/ref/integrity and forbidden-construction failures remain nonsemantic admission/completion/audit codes and never canonical V554_LIMIT rows.

containment_amendment.A_semantic_negative_vs_validation: V554_LIMIT contains only downstream-meaningful semantic/use limits that may lawfully exist in a valid publication. Transport/schema invalidity, fact-association mismatch, synthetic-ID fallback attempts, forbidden-inference attempts, aggregate-only substitute attempts, unknown/ungoverned-rule attempts and ungoverned-score attempts are fail-closed admission/completion/audit codes and never F3 semantic rows.
containment_amendment.B_handoff_reclassification: V554 has four semantic families at most. V554_V555_HANDOFF is one governed boundary/interface family B1, not a V554 semantic meaning family. The physical handoff artifact and exact-reference strategy are preserved.
containment_amendment.C_positive_affordance_model: BOUNDED_STRUCTURAL_AFFORDANCE is genuinely positive/conditional and materializes only ELIGIBLE or CONDITIONAL. UNRESOLVED/BLOCKED/NOT_APPLICABLE/VALIDATION_FAILURE are candidate decision outcomes. CONDITIONAL is legal only when all upstream/V554 eligibility authority is satisfied and every remaining unresolved requirement is explicitly V555-owned.

No canonical V554-specific numeric strength/confidence/specificity/certifiability score is accepted absent a separately governed formula and interpretation.
V554_V555_HANDOFF is governed boundary/interface rather than semantic family.
BOUNDED_STRUCTURAL_AFFORDANCE materializes only ELIGIBLE or lawful CONDITIONAL rows.

components.name: PublicationManifestAndCompletionCourt
components.law: Write canonical allowlist, hashes/schema/rule versions, finite readiness verdict and nonsemantic failure/audit evidence. Valid-empty may complete successfully. Failed integrity/admission attempts never become F3.
